record.question: Under Section 153, when might a Court report the circumstances of a case to the High Court or another authority regarding a question asked by an advocate?
options: If the question was asked with reasonable grounds but is found to be prejudicial
If the Court believes the question was asked without reasonable grounds
If the question was asked in a manner deemed too aggressive by the advocate
If the question was irrelevant to the case
